description: This source file contains unit tests for an EventBus implementation, including subscribe, unsubscribe, publish functionalities, concurrency, and type-specific tests.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Subscribe
methods.description: Tests subscribing to the event bus and verifies the subscriber channel is created and the count is correct.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Subscribe_Multiple
methods.description: Tests multiple subscriptions and checks the total subscriber count.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Unsubscribe
methods.description: Tests unsubscribing a subscriber and ensures the channel is closed.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Unsubscribe_NotSubscribed
methods.description: Unsubscribing a non-existing subscriber should not cause panic.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Publish_SingleSubscriber
methods.description: Tests that a published event is received by a single subscriber.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Publish_MultipleSubscribers
methods.description: Ensures all subscribers receive the event.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Publish_NoSubscribers
methods.description: Publishing with no subscribers should not panic.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Publish_AfterUnsubscribe
methods.description: Verifies that subscribers do not receive events after unsubscribing and their channels are closed.

methods.name: TestEventBus_SubscriberCount
methods.description: Checks the correctness of the subscriber count after various subscribe/unsubscribe actions.

methods.name: TestEventBus_ConcurrentSubscribeUnsubscribePublish
methods.description: Tests concurrent subscribe, unsubscribe, and publishing to ensure thread safety.

methods.name: TestEventBus_ConcurrentPublish
methods.description: Tests concurrent publishing of multiple events and verifying receipt.

methods.name: TestEventBus_SlowSubscriber
methods.description: Verifies that a slow subscriber does not block the publisher.

methods.name: TestEventBus_CustomType
methods.description: Tests publishing and receiving custom struct types.

methods.name: TestEventBus_EventOrdering
methods.description: Ensures events are received in the order they are published.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Resubscribe
methods.description: Tests resubscribing after an unsubscribe to ensure a new channel is created and events are received.
